en: Black-and-white postcard showing a small Byzantine stone church surrounded by a low metal fence in an urban setting. Behind it rise larger neoclassical and modern buildings. The foreground church has a tiled roof, arched windows, carved stone decorations, and a small dome. Printed captions in Greek and French at the bottom identify the site as a Byzantine church in Athens, dedicated to St. Eleutherios (also called Gorgoepikoos). A web address watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower right.
